title: BIOBOND: HELIX — World & Environment Overhaul (WIP)
author: Studio_Red_Coin
selftext:
A little gameplay showcase of the direction we're pushing BIOBOND: HELIX. 🌱

Seamless terrain, denser foliage, environmental props, and dynamic weather—all coming together to make Genevo feel more alive. This is still a work in progress and needs a polish pass, but this is the kind of environmental overhaul we're striving for.

We've been experimenting with tools like PixelLab AI and Claude as part of a strongly human-driven development and art workflow, using them to accelerate iteration without losing creative direction.

The part we're especially happy with? Performance. With the full environment loaded, including foliage, props, and weather, we're hitting **\~490 FPS (2.09 ms/frame)** uncapped. Weather adds only around **0.02 ms** compared to clear conditions.

Still plenty of work ahead, but we're excited about where this is going. 👀
